import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import statsmodels.api as sm
from statsmodels.formula.api import ols

# Load the dataset
invaded_niche = pd.read_csv('/data/invaded_niche_pathways.csv')

# Display the first few rows of the dataset
invaded_niche.head()

# Check for missing values
invaded_niche.isnull().sum()

# Check the data types
invaded_niche.dtypes

# Check the summary statistics
invaded_niche.describe()

# Check the correlation matrix
correlation_matrix = invaded_niche.corr()
correlation_matrix[['n.gard']].sort_values(by='n.gard', ascending=False)

# Perform a multiple regression analysis to determine the factors that interact significantly with 'n.gard'
model = ols('n.gard ~ cropland.1956.50m + urban.1956.50m + cropland.1993.50m + urban.1993.50m + cropland.2009.50m + urban.2009.50m + progressive.1956.2009.50m + regressive.1956.2009.50m + no.changes.1956.2009.50m + progressive.1993.2009.50m + regressive.1993.2009.50m + no.changes.1993.2009.50m + distance.stream + distance.road + annual.temperature + annual.rainfall + annual.radiation', data=invaded_niche).fit()
model.summary()

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import scipy.stats as stats
import statsmodels.api as sm

# Load the dataset with a tab delimiter
invaded_niche = pd.read_csv('/data/invaded_niche_pathways.csv', delimiter='\t')

# Drop non-numeric columns
numeric_columns = invaded_niche.select_dtypes(include=[np.number]).columns.tolist()
invaded_niche_numeric = invaded_niche[numeric_columns]

invaded_niche_numeric.head()

invaded_niche_numeric.isnull().sum()

invaded_niche_numeric.dtypes

invaded_niche_numeric.describe()

correlation_matrix = invaded_niche_numeric.corr()
correlation_matrix[['n.gard']].sort_values(by='n.gard', ascending=False)

# Perform a multiple regression analysis
X = invaded_niche_numeric.drop(columns=['n.gard'])
y = invaded_niche_numeric['n.gard']

# Add a constant to the model (intercept)
X = sm.add_constant(X)

# Fit the regression model
model = sm.OLS(y, X).fit()
model.summary()
